canonicalInstructionsUnchanged: Set a barbell in a rack near shoulder height. Take a grip just outside shoulder width, brace the trunk, and step back with the bar at the front of the shoulders.
Press overhead while keeping the ribs down and moving the head just enough to let the bar pass.
Lower to the front of the shoulders without leaning back, then return the bar to the rack after the set.
rationale: The frontend currently supports the established single-start path. Use the original valid shoulder-height Graphic 3D reference for one explicit corrective motion attempt, with a two-second complete-overhead inspection pause. Failed endpoint stills remain failed and unchanged.

referenceGeometryJudgment.decision: A bounded single-start corrective attempt is reasonable; no intrinsic reference geometry blocker was found.
evidence: Reinspected the actual original 768 × 1376 shoulder-height master. The whole bar, both grips and both shoes are visible, with substantial empty space above the head.

The bar and grips do not appear to prevent a complete overhead press. Preserving ordinary arm lengths and using the available overhead room appears feasible without shrinking the body or changing camera.

The three-quarter view foreshortens the farther upper arm, so complete endpoint readability is not guaranteed. Dense actual-output review must establish a clear far-elbow extension rather than accepting the near arm alone.
referenceGeometryJudgment.limitation: A still cannot establish exact 3D clearance or future motion success. If the next output again omits a clear complete endpoint, keep it flagged; do not claim that text alone proves correct range.

motionProposal.title: Graphic 3D · Press and return · Endpoint correction
motionProposal.caption: Starts at the front shoulders. Press overhead, pause with both arms extended, then lower under control. Follow Form for rack setup and reracking.
motionProposal.alt: Overhead Press from the original fixed three-quarter view: one shoulder-height press to a clearly extended overhead pause, followed by a controlled return to the front shoulders.
motionProposal.teachingCoverage: One standing press and real return with a two-second overhead inspection pause. Canonical rack setup and reracking remain in Form.
reviewGates: Same logical motion shot; only one actual generated OHP motion exists, so this is corrective generated attempt 2. Reconcile any pre-submit ledger failures explicitly rather than inventing a new shot.
Confirm the exact original shoulder-height master and its existing ready-to-animate evidence before spending. No substitution of the later failed stills.
Both arms visibly extend through their full natural length; the far elbow cannot retain the previous bent goalpost endpoint.
Maximum overhead position is held clearly for about two seconds; both complete hands and bar ends remain in frame.
No bar-through-face penetration, knee drive, backward lean, limb shortening, camera change or equipment deformation.
The bar returns to the actual front shoulders by about 7 seconds and the final second remains still. No extra pulse or second repetition.
Review dense ascent, overhead pause and descent frames plus exact endpoints; record uncertainty from projection without inventing numerical angles.
This proposal does not automatically authorize a third generated motion or any further still. If the second output is unclear, hold it for review and retain prior comparisons.
